teams.mirassol_identity_basis: dataset lacks labels; unique ambiguous 33-point/8-win identity

metadata.packed_screens: above >=5716; below <=5716; exact ties are unresolved and screens can overlap; these are necessary packed screens, not full GD ranking
metadata.h1: structural required-win effort/slack; no probability claim
metadata.h2: independent exact packed marginal product; independence approximation/allocation score; Pal all-loss prior appears once and is common constant
metadata.h3: candidate-local iterative support filtering capped at four passes per team/domain; score uses fixture-domain mass once and separate all-above/all-below packed marginal products; allocation heuristic, not exact feasibility
metadata.h4: shared-fixture multivariate packed Chernoff allocation log score; minimized signed log-MGF with 24/128 L-BFGS-B caps for normal/large runs; not a probability
metadata.h5: normal H4 plus shared-Pal-GD 15-node Gauss-Hermite product of conditional normal tie factors; uses shared rival-Pal covariance; Poisson goal margins are truncated at 14 goals and renormalized; omits rival-rival goal covariance and goals-for; not a bound

normal_large.normal: H4 24 L-BFGS-B iterations, H5 15 GH nodes
normal_large.large: H4 128 L-BFGS-B iterations, H5 31 GH nodes

beam.method: deterministic H2 descending, candidate_id ascending tie-break
beam.not_evaluated_outside_beam: score and rank null; evaluated false; no fallback
